evidence: Matches the Private Broadcast label prior and directly targets transaction origin privacy by altering how unconfirmed transactions are re-exposed to peers.
rationale: Disabling wallet resubmissions under `-privatebroadcast` prevents a node from exposing itself as the origin over clearnet when the wider network has dropped a transaction. This fixes a clear privacy leak where locally retained transactions are served to peers upon request, contradicting the privacy guarantees expected under `-privatebroadcast`.
